arxiv-1904-06511.creator: Anver Hisham, Di Yuan, Erik G. Ström
arxiv-1904-06511.description: Abstract This paper investigate how to mitigate the impact of adjacent channel interference (ACI) in vehicular broadcast communication, using scheduling and power control. Our objective is to maximize the number of connected vehicles. First, we formulate the joint scheduling and power control problem as a mixed Boolean linear programming (MBLP) problem.

arxiv-2010-06422.title: SOUND EVENT LOCALIZATION AND DETECTION BASED ON CRNN USING RECTANGULAR FILTERS AND CHANNEL ROTATION DATA AUGMENTATION
arxiv-2010-06422.description: A 2020 arXiv research paper by . Sound Event Localization and Detection refers to the problem of identifying the presence of independent or temporally-overlapped sound sources, correctly identifying to which sound class it belongs, and estimating their spatial directions while they are active. In the last years, neural networks have become the prevailing method for Sound Event Localization and Detection task, with convolutional recurrent neural networks being among the most used systems.

arxiv-2106-16049.description: Abstract Graph Networks (GNs) enable the fusion of prior knowledge and relational reasoning with flexible function approximations. In this work, a general GN-based model is proposed which takes full advantage of the relational modeling capabilities of GNs and extends these to probabilistic modeling with Variational Bayes (VB).

Green supplier selection is one of the most important problems in GSCM, which satisfies a firm’s environmental goals as well as its economic targets.

arxiv-2212-02776.title: Quantum vacuum, rotation, and nonlinear fields
arxiv-2212-02776.creator: Antonino Flachi, Matthew Edmonds
arxiv-2212-02776.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Antonino Flachi, Matthew Edmonds. In this paper, we extend previous results on the quantum vacuum or Casimir energy, for a noninteracting rotating system and for an interacting nonrotating system, to the case where both rotation and interactions are present. Concretely, we first reconsider the noninteracting rotating case of a scalar field theory and propose an alternative and simpler method to compute the Casimir energy based on a replica trick and the Coleman-Weinberg effective potential.

pmc-12736524.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). The vehicle sideslip angle is a core state parameter in vehicle dynamics control.
